title: Fixed Through-Post Twin-Rope Dock Rail
description: One complete static dock-edge rope rail: two thick rectangular timber posts each have two genuine through apertures; two complete sagged closed rope strands pass through those apertures and terminate in enlarged integral end-stop collars outside both posts. Two complete finite rectangular metal base plates support the posts. Six editable closed meshes and three opaque solid PBR roles. Entire post-with-two-hole boundaries and continuous rope/end-stop profiles are newly authored, not an old pointed-picket fence with bars removed or a court fence recoloured; not a mooring bollard. Compared with the existing turned-stanchion queue barrier using external solid studs and separate ferrules, these strands pass through four true rectangular post apertures and meet external stop shoulders; the construction is not merely two copies of its rope, a height change or a wood-colour swap. One original fishing-plan dock rail prop, no separately counted post/rope/plate components. Metres, Z up, front -Y, centered whole bounds, real flat plate soles at Z0. Fixed static visual configuration only: no restraint or guardrail rating, safe dock edge, rope tension, material strength, durability, manufacture, bolt anchorage, load, compliant movement or real mooring function is asserted.
